limits: Resume requires a new completed provider-owned SDK checkpoint, matching Pi history and unchanged prompt/tools/environment/output cap.
Saved Pi sessions now also retain native SDK transcripts. Deleting Pi history does not delete its SDK copy.
Stop closes the query; continuation after cancellation remains unsupported.
Compaction, forks/tree navigation, arbitrary/cross-provider history, dynamic prompt/tool changes, and steering during tool batches remain unsupported.
Helpers receive transcript JSON as data, not a role-preserving replay, and cannot execute tools.
Explicit output caps validate against the catalogue; full 128000-token output was not tested.
Mobile Chromium is not real-iPhone/Safari verification. Settlement timing is not OS child-process exit timing.
Intermediate/cancelled usage is estimated. SDK nominal cost is not subscription billing or balance proof.
Full repository suite and CI results were not checked locally.
